title: Unify SDK auth/retries & streaming ergonomics; parity fixes across Python/TypeScript/Go; bump v1.143.0
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: We continue to see divergent SDK behaviours across Python/TypeScript/Go around auth retry semantics and streaming ergonomics which causes application-layer retries and inconsistent developer ergonomics. This PR unifies the auth+retry behavior, improves streaming client ergonomics (cancellation, backpressure, reconnect semantics), and applies parity fixes across all three SDKs. Summary of changes: - Introduce a shared AuthRetryPolicy abstraction used by all SDKs (token refresh, 401->retry, idempotent request heuristics). - Standardize retry/backoff defaults: exponential backoff with jitter, max attempts configurable via SDK client options, and explicit opt-out. - Streaming ergonomics: add a unified StreamingClient interface with cancel(), pause()/resume() hooks (TS/Python), and context-aware cancellation for Go. Add guidance and examples for reconnecting and resuming streams. - Parity fixes: align API surface and option names between SDKs, fix missing metadata propagation for streaming events, and ensure consistent error types and codes across language bindings. - Version bumps to v1.143.0 for Python/TS/Go packages and corresponding changelogs. Backwards compatibility: defaults preserved where possible; opt-in flags for stricter retry enforcement. Checklist: - [x] Design doc referenced in ENG-2045 - [x] API surface smoke tested in sample apps (redwood-examples/chat-streaming) - [x] Unit + integration tests added/updated - [x] Updated SDK docs and CHANGELOGs - [x] CI green after flaky test fixes Notes: This PR is intentionally conservative about changing defaults. The primary goal is parity and predictable behaviour for customers using multiple language SDKs. Follow-ups (ENG-2110): opt-in strict-mode retries for non-idempotent streaming calls, telemetry for retry reasons, and a small perf pass for streaming buffer allocations.

comments: Diego Martinez: Nice consolidation — can you clarify retry behavior for non-idempotent streaming writes? We should document recommended usage patterns.

Ava Chen: Reply: We default to no automatic retries for non-idempotent streaming writes. The AuthRetryPolicy only retries idempotent HTTP calls and 401 token refreshes. I've added docs and an explicit opt-in flag `retryNonIdempotentStreams` (default=false).
Priya Singh: Tests look comprehensive. Suggest adding a small example in the TS quickstart showing pause()/resume() usage.
Ava Chen: Reply: Added a brief snippet in redwood-examples/chat-streaming/ts/example.ts and linked it from the docs.
Liam O'Connor: CI had a flaky streaming test previously — re-run after fixing the test harness. Looks good to me; approve.
